research_question: Does the ordinary-session pass-through from pre-auction SGX A50 price discovery into the next CSI1000 opening gap vary continuously with the mainland market's already-known recent realized-volatility state?
financial_mechanism: A fixed coefficient assumes that the same offshore China price move maps into the mainland opening gap identically in calm and fragile mainland states. The v8 interaction tests exactly one state-dependent pass-through elasticity while preserving both main effects.

new_feature.name: a50_ordinary_x_rvol20
new_feature.A50_component: exact frozen v6 ordinary-session A50 feature ending strictly before 09:15
new_feature.state_component: exact frozen baseline rvol20 feature without redefinition
new_feature.hierarchy: both main effects remain in the model
new_feature.holiday_semantics: exactly zero because a50_ordinary_preauction_closure_return is frozen to zero on holiday rows

common_sample.rule: Use the exact frozen v6 common frame and complete-case rules for both comparator and candidate; the deterministic interaction introduces no additional missingness beyond its two existing main effects.
common_sample.comparator_replay: V6A comparator must replay the sealed v6 same-sample metrics within frozen numerical tolerance before v8 may be adjudicated

attempts.features: exact frozen v6 feature set + a50_ordinary_x_rvol20

primary_adjudication.same_sample_R2: V8A holdout R2 > V6A holdout R2
primary_adjudication.same_sample_SSE: V8A holdout SSE < V6A holdout SSE
primary_adjudication.IC: V8A holdout IC > V6A holdout IC
primary_adjudication.sign_hit: V8A sign hit may not deteriorate by more than 0.01 absolute versus V6A
primary_adjudication.ordinary_mechanism: ordinary-session SSE must improve and ordinary-session IC must not be lower than V6A
primary_adjudication.annual_stability: V8A SSE must not be worse than V6A in either 2019 or 2020
primary_adjudication.quarterly_stability: across the eight 2019-2020 calendar quarters, total SSE improvement must be positive, median quarterly SSE improvement must be positive, and at least five of eight quarters must have nonnegative SSE improvement
primary_adjudication.holiday_preservation: holiday-subset SSE must not be worse than V6A because the new interaction is exactly zero on holiday rows and should not damage the separately frozen holiday mechanism through coefficient redistribution

split rvol20 into high/low buckets after results for candidate selection
